key_points: Analyst downgrades: Zacks rates LVS "Strong Sell" and other ratings have been cut.
Earnings miss and 21% EBITDA decline highlight weakening profitability.
Significant institutional selling: ARGA Investment Management sold 237,501 shares.
Stock only modestly above its 50‑day moving average, indicating limited bullish momentum.
Positive coverage (GuruFocus undervaluation, $53.28 price target) is outweighed by negative fundamentals.
